article.title: Removing federal protections for wolves would be catastrophic
article.author: Editor
article.content: Keeping federal protections in place is our first line of defense against trophy hunting and recreational trapping, and our members of Congress and officials at the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service must hear that message from us. The post Removing federal protections for wolves would be catastrophic appeared first on MR Online .
